title: Samuel Kofi Tetteh Baah | Economist, Global Poverty and Inequality Data (GPID), Development Data Group, World Bank
gist: Author profile page for Samuel Kofi Tetteh Baah, a World Bank GPID economist who works on global poverty measurement, including the technical work behind the new international poverty line and twice-yearly global poverty updates. It lists his posts, most recently a century-long view of extreme poverty (October 2026).
